about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: American Crystal Sugar Company
channels.legal_basis: N.D. Admin. Code 33.1-16-02.1-11(4): immediate report to the Department of Environmental Quality of a spill or discharge that causes or is likely to cause water pollution; the permit's standard conditions (NDG420000 Part IV(F) for the domestic-treatment general permit; 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)): an oral report within 24 hours and a written one within five days
channels.note: American Crystal Sugar Company reports a spill or overflow to DEQ immediately, and under its permit within 24 hours and in writing within five days. Since 2021 the reports go into the unified spill system, whose public list answers 403 to the project's identified client; no North Dakota rule requires it to tell the public.
